title: [review] tx_queue.py:289: No validation that deadline_ms
description: The deadline_ms parameter accepts any int without validation. A caller could pass deadline_ms=0 or a negative value, causing the packet to be immediately expired on the next expire_stale() call. While this may be intentional for re-queue scenarios, an explicit check (e.g., deadline_ms > now or at minimum > 0) would prevent subtle bugs from bad inputs.
